simple.meaning: גִּדּוּף (giddûwph) is a Hebrew word meaning “vilification.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גִּדּוּף (H1421) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 43:28, with occurrences in Isaiah, Zephaniah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גִּדּוּף (H1421) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גִּדּוּף (H1421) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גִּדּוּף (giddûwph) / H1421 is traced through Isaiah 43:28, Isaiah 51:7, Zephaniah 2:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1421. gidduph גִּדּוּפִים noun masculine plural revilings, reviling words — ׳ג Isa 43:28 ; construct ׳גִּדֻּפֵ Zeph 2:8 ; suffix גִּדֻּפֹתָם Isa 51:7 between men, 43:28 (|| חֵרֶם ); 51:7 ; Zeph 2:8 (both || חֶרְמָּה ).
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) גִּדֻּף ; and (feminine) גִּדּוּפָה xlit giddûphâh corrected to giddûwphâh ; or גִּדֻּפָה ; from 1422 ;

occurrences.englishText: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary;
“Listen to me, you who know righteousness,
I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
